editorial.blurb: Connie's is a beloved neighborhood spot where deep-dish pizza and creamy pasta shine, backed by genuinely attentive service and a warm, nostalgic atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for Astrid if you can—reviewers rave about her attentive, genuine service elevating every visit. Come on a Saturday night when live entertainment is playing.
